bounded_coxiter_corpus_replay.scope_warning: These two pinned CoxIter lanes are not a publication-complete denominator; literal header absence is not worldwide novelty.

centralizer_conjugacy.conclusion: for each fixed N, both path phases and all eight listed constructions give one exact lattice-isometry class; this does not enumerate or classify path-cube configurations outside the listed eight

phase_swap_within_configuration_1.consequence: the two alternating path phases are isometric for every N; conjugacy transports the swap to the other seven configurations

doubling_stock.criterion: no incident odd finite Coxeter exponent

independence.method: raw GAP source parse; independent fixed-lattice/root reconstruction; independent group, boundary, all-z collision, and centralizer closure

all_integer_collision_audit.domain: all z in Z, both branches T^z and T^z*S_right, both root signs, all 939x939 ordered side-facet pairs
all_integer_collision_audit.method: T^z=I+zK+z(z-1)K^2/2 with K^3=0; for each moving source, solve its first nonconstant integer coordinate against every signed target coordinate value, then verify all 13 coordinates by exact hash

carrier.scope: weak full-Picard divisor-reflection carrier; no full-nef or surface-automorphism assertion

universal_family.configuration_classification_scope: exact only for the eight listed configurations; no exhaustiveness claim for other path-cube configurations
universal_family.coxeter_reason: the C2^3 kernel glues eight chambers across three commuting doubling walls, while the index-N reflection subgroup of the parallel-wall D_infinity factor glues N consecutive cube chambers; the two factors commute and every exterior pair passes the exact collision/Coxeter gate
universal_family.finite_volume_reason: P_N is the union of exactly 8N interiors-disjoint finite-volume seed chambers
universal_family.full_lattice_reason: each phase boundary contains a 940-root endpoint deletion with Smith diagonal 1^13; conjugacy transports this to all eight configurations
universal_family.integrality_reason: all boundary roots are images of primitive seed roots under integral lattice isometries, so primitivity and integral reflectivity persist
universal_family.noncompact_reason: the union contains the noncompact seed chamber, equivalently retains an ideal direction; a finite union containing it cannot be compact
universal_family.universal_proof: the exact all-z solve classifies every side-wall identification and excludes negative, cross-facet, and endpoint-side collisions; the outer-end equations leave exactly two endpoints
